questions.q: The method of zone refining of metals is based on the principle of
options: greater mobility of the pure metal than that of impurity.
greater solubility of the impurity in the molten state than in the solid.
higher melting point of the impurity than that of the pure metal.
questions.solution: A movable heater is fitted around a rod of impure metal. As heater is moved from one end to another pure metal crystallises while impurities pass on to adjacent melted zone.

II in haematite and II, III in magnetite
III in haematite and II, III in magnetite

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.chapter: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals
questions.q:
Among the following metals the number of metals that are extracted by self-reduction method from their respective ores is
Hg, Zn, Cu, Al, Mg, Pb, Fe, Na.
questions.solution:
Self-Reduction Process: The cations of the less electropositive metals like Pb, Hg and Cu may be reduced without the use of any additional reducing agent.
Self-reduction of Cu:
2Cu2O + Cu2S→ 6Cu + SO2g
It is called self-reducing because copper oxide itself reduced the copper sulfide to give copper and sulfur dioxide.
Similar reactions occurs for Pb and Hg.

questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which of the following statements, about the advantage of roasting of sulphide ore before reduction is not true?
options: the magnitude of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msubsup></math> of the sulphide is greater than those for <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>

the  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msubsup></math>  is negative for roasting of sulphide ore to oxide
roasting of the sulphide to the oxide is thermodynamically feasible
carbon and hydrogen are suitable reducing agents for metal sulphides
questions.solution: The standard free energies of formation  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msubsup></mrow></mfenced></math>  of most of the sulphides are greater than those of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> . Hence, neither carbon nor hydrogen can reduce metal sulphides to metal. The standard free energies of formation of oxides are much lower than those of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> . Therefore, oxidation of metal sulphides to metal oxides is thermodynamically favourable. Hence sulphide ore is roasted to the oxide before reduction.

Electrolytic reduction of metallic oxide to metal

questions.q: The correct statement is
options: leaching of bauxite using concentrated NaOH solution gives sodium aluminate and sodium silicate

the blistered appearance of copper during the metallurgical process is due to the evolution of  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>
pig iron is obtained from cast iron
the Hall-Heroult process is used for the production of aluminium and iron
questions.solution:
(1) During leaching when bauxite is treated with concentrated NaOH, then sodium aluminate and sodium silicate is formed in the soluble form, whereas Fe2O3 is precipitated.

Cu2S+2Cu2O→6Cu+SO2

(3) Cast iron is obtained from pig iron

Pig iron4% →blast of air cast iron3%

(4) Hall-Heroult process is used for production of only aluminium.

Carnellite is KCl ⋅  MgCl 2  ⋅  6H 2 O
It is a white or reddish mineral consisting of a hydrated chloride of potassium ( K ) and magnesium ( Mg ) . Therefore, Carnellite is a mineral of Mg.

questions.solution:
It is a case of self reduction.

The concentrated galena (PbS) is partially oxidised by adjusting the air supply.

PbS + 2 O 2 → PbSO 4

The temperature is raised, air supply reduced and fresh galena (PbS) added.

PbS + PbSO 4 → 2 Pb + 2 SO 2 ↑
